_comment: Map of the dead ICQ web services. Rules are matched top to bottom and the
first hit wins, so the catch-all comes last.
host: an exact name, '*.suffix', or '*' for any.
path: a case-insensitive regular expression over the path. Absent means any.
action: what to do (see below). target: where to, with {...} substitutions.
Actions:
drop        an immediate 404. For ads and feeds: what matters is not the
body but that the client does not hang until the TCP timeout.
blank       a transparent 1x1 GIF. For the banner strip, which expects an
image and draws a broken-image icon for anything else.
search      redirect a search query, {q} is the string from ?q=
redirect    redirect to target
today       the "who is online" panel
whitepages  look a user up by number
whitepagesicon a user's static picture for the user card, relayed from the management API
map         Google Maps at the address the "Map" button sends
pager       web pager: the form and sending a message
hostsfile   serve a ready-made hosts block for the client
welcome     the welcome page shown after sign-in
center      the owner's unified messaging center
help        the help page: signing in, account, calls, what is gone
about       about the service
legal       legal notice and privacy, with the terms of use
terms       the terms of use
download    the clients that work and the patches, from downloads below
tzer        a tZer movie or thumbnail from the tzers folder, by exact name
avatarfiles an animated avatar or its thumbnail from the avatars folder, by exact name
avatargallery the avatar gallery list (2007 XML) with our animated avatars
ruffle      Ruffle's web build from the ruffle folder, by exact name; the user card plays the animated avatar with it
miranda     Miranda NG's PluginUpdater list and packages: the upstream stable ones with our plugins in them
stub        a "this service is gone" page
Substitutions in target: {registerBase}, {q}, {host}, {path}.
_links: How the pages link to each other. The default paths suit the "own address" mode; when the ICQ.com names are intercepted, replace them with http://wwp.icq.com/wwp/.

routes.note: cb.icq.com: the banner strip in the contact list
update.icq.com: update packages, machine-readable
cb.icq.com: content bundle descriptors the client parses itself
the list the original avatar gallery loaded, in its 2007 form, pointing at our animated avatars
the Xtraz page wrapper, unused while the list is a 404
the DTD ICQ 6 fetches before parsing the Xtraz list
the Xtraz list: answered with an empty list so the client drops every Xtraz button it had cached
Xtraz lists and teaser images the client parses itself
the Xtraz gallery package list, machine-readable
openxtraz.icq.com: the Xtraz add-on catalogue, machine-readable
ADTECH ad slots
short paths for the links baked into Icq.exe: a string can only be replaced by one no longer than itself
The service's own addresses. A client is pointed at them through its own config, so the Host header can be anything: the server address is chosen by whoever runs the client, not by the ICQ.com names.
"How to Start" from the contact list: a short guide instead of a stub
ICQ 6.5 Help menu: a help page for this server instead of help.icq.com
ICQ 6.5 Help > About: what this service is
legal notice and privacy
the terms link of the sign-in window; its ?lspid= and lang= are ignored
the clients that work and the patches for them
tZer movies and thumbnails from the tzers folder, by exact file name; ICQ 6.5 with the patch's tZers player lists them in tzer.xml

animated avatars (Flash devils) and their thumbnails from the avatars folder, by exact file name; the picture page hands the client these addresses, and every contact's client fetches the movie from here over plain HTTP
PluginUpdater of Miranda NG: /miranda/stable/x32 and /x64 are its update address; hashes.zip is upstream's with our plugins put in, their packages are ours, the rest is relayed from upstream
Ruffle's web build (the loader, its chunk and the WebAssembly), by exact file name; the user card loads it to play an animated avatar in a browser without Flash
receives a picture from the picture page
hands that picture to the client, which uploads it to the server
the page that sets the user's own picture, opened as the "avatar" Xtra
the "ICQ Welcome" window after sign-in: server state and what works
the "Map" button of a user's home address: redirects to Google Maps
the user's static picture on the user card; the management API behind it stays reachable only from this machine
the "User's Unified Messaging Center" button in the message window
profile, password and e-mail address, all on one page
the client's "delete number" item, pointed at our management page
old addresses from clients that have not been retargeted yet lead to the same guide
content bundles: the payload of the ad banners
the news feed for the ticker line
ads.web.aol.com and the rest of the AOL advertising
the search box in the client window, forwarded to a search engine that still exists
World Wide Pager: message a user without a client
a panel inside the client, receives ?icquin=
the stock "forgot password" item leads to our recovery page
and to our registration page
xtraz.icq.com: the picture gallery, greetings and mini-games
labs.icq.com: help, guides and the problem report form
the client's other ad requests
emoticon packs for ICQ 6

hostsFile.note: The names the client has to resolve to this service. The list is separate from routes: it also covers hosts served by the catch-all stub.

_contact: An e-mail address or a web page for questions about this server, shown on /icq/about and /icq/legal. Empty: no contact line. TODO: fill in before the server is public. CONTACT in the environment overrides it.
_downloads: Where the patches are published, listed on /icq/download. A value that is empty or starts with TODO is shown as not published yet.

downloads.mirandaPlugin: TODO: the address of the Miranda NG plugin, IcqOscarJ.dll for x32 and x64 (tools/miranda-icq/build)

_oscarHost: The server address for clients, shown in the "how to start" guide. Leave empty to drop that section.
